review.notes: Full review of the head that restores the layers and items of the roadmap on main. Record: README at the merge base compared with the head layer by layer and item by item (R1-R5, R5.1-R5.3), nothing removed, no id changed, completed items name declarations found at the pinned Tau Ceti. Sources: all 22 locators read in the texts (Frenkel 2007 from the author's page, Frenkel-Gaitsgory and Johnson-Yau from arXiv), including the fifteen sampled sections 1.3, 2.1-2.3, 3.1-3.5, 4.1-4.3, 5.1-5.3. Adversarial pass: every Check recomputed (21 table rows with values). Library: every name in code font searched at the pins, about forty declarations opened. Suppliers AffineLieAlgebras and FormalConnectionsOpers resolved on main. Automatic checks all passed, none set aside; dependency check 0 problems; Suggested.lean elaborates with no message (no declarations; no headline statable at the pins, docstring says why). Small corrections: the description calls Suggested.lean unchanged though 28 declarations are removed against main; section 2.2 names a library lemma that states a different fact. Format notes N01-N03 carried from the previous review.
